title: Built-in tag helpers / forms / selects / infrastructure
meaning: Built-in MVC tag helpers transform server-side asp-* attributes into proper HTML.
Form-related helpers include form, input, label, textarea, select/option, validation message and validation summary helpers.
Navigation/rendering helpers include anchor, partial, environment, script/link/image and similar helpers.
Tag helpers keep Razor markup HTML-like while still binding to routes, model expressions, validation and static asset behavior.
Tag helper infrastructure requires imports such as @addTagHelper and runs during Razor rendering, not during controller execution.
boundary_notes: R04 covers Cache Tag Helper, view components, display templates and worked UI examples.
